note: Official Obelisk bots. ecosystem.config.cjs registers each one only once its nsecEnv is set in .env.local (off by default on a fresh host); the manager lists them all and turns them on from the dashboard.

bots.title: Zap bot
bots.description: Announces every NIP-57 zap that happens inside your NIP-29 groups.

extraEnv.label: Extra relays to listen for zap receipts (comma-separated)

bots.notes: Empty groups = every group on the relays the bot can see.

bots.title: Ranks bot
bots.description: XP, levels, fortnightly ranking, jury votes and padrinos (port of La Crypta's Discord ranks bot).
bots.notes: The relay must whitelist the bot's npub. Then send !canal-niveles in the channel that should receive level-up messages.

bots.title: BTC price bot
bots.description: BTC/USD ticker in its profile name, periodic summaries, and !btc / !price / !ath / !stats.
